title: Polylang translation links follow renumbered posts; Tracy's language changes are named, not sent half-way
steps: Run the real MariaDB Polylang cases for Sync from live, Sync to live and the sync after a push.
expect: Translation groups, term languages and per-language menus follow post and term renumbers.
A post or term whose language or group Tracy changed is named, not sent; one in an unchanged group goes.
After a push, the copy keeps the term rows the push never sent.

tests: WordPress: a post or category whose Polylang language or translation group Tracy changed is named, not sent; one in an unchanged group goes (#105)
Polylang translation groups, term languages and per-language menus follow post and term renumbers (#105)
WordPress: a live Polylang translation renumbered by Sync keeps its translation link on the copy, and the next Preview offers no false change (#105)
